import numpy as np, json
from skimage import measure, color
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
from ora_lib import geometry as G

def hsv_of(rgb):
    img = rgb[...,:3].astype(np.float64)/255.0
    return color.rgb2hsv(img)

def piece_masks(rgb):
    hsv = hsv_of(rgb); hue,sat,val = hsv[...,0],hsv[...,1],hsv[...,2]
    out = {
      "blue":   (hue>0.55)&(hue<0.72)&(sat>0.5)&(val>0.15),
      "yellow": (hue>0.10)&(hue<0.22)&(sat>0.6)&(val>0.5),
      "purple": (hue>0.75)&(hue<0.93)&(sat>0.45)&(val>0.2),
      "orange": (hue>0.01)&(hue<0.09)&(val>0.85)&(sat>0.5),
    }
    for k in out: out[k][:200,:]=False; out[k][380:,:]=False
    return out

def world_cloud(mask, dep, K, T):
    vs,us = np.nonzero(mask)
    d = dep[vs,us].astype(float)
    ok = np.isfinite(d)&(d>0.05)&(d<3.0)
    uv = np.stack([us[ok],vs[ok]],1).astype(float)
    xyz = G.back_project(uv, d[ok], K)
    return uv, G.transform_points(xyz, T), d[ok]

def fit_plane(P):
    c = P.mean(0); u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(P-c); n = vt[2]
    if n[2] < 0: n = -n
    return c, n, (P-c)@n

def ray_plane(cam_xyz, uv, K, T, c, n):
    Kinv = np.linalg.inv(K)
    rays = Kinv @ np.array([uv[0], uv[1], 1.0])
    R = T[:3,:3]
    d_world = R @ rays
    o_world = T[:3,3]
    t = ((c-o_world)@n)/(d_world@n)
    return o_world + t*d_world

def analyze(rgb, dep, K, T):
    res = []
    ms = piece_masks(rgb)
    for cls, m in ms.items():
        lab = measure.label(m)
        for rp in measure.regionprops(lab):
            if rp.area < 150: continue
            mask = (lab==rp.label)
            filled = ndi.binary_fill_holes(mask)
            holes = filled & ~mask
            hl = measure.label(holes); hinfo=[]
            for hr in measure.regionprops(hl):
                if 5 <= hr.area <= 300:
                    hinfo.append((hr.area, hr.centroid[1], hr.centroid[0]))
            hinfo.sort(key=lambda t:-t[0])
            uv, P, d = world_cloud(mask, dep, K, T)
            c, n, r = fit_plane(P)
            top = P[r > np.percentile(r, 60)]
            ct, nt, rt = fit_plane(top)
            entry = dict(cls=cls, area=int(rp.area), bbox=[int(v) for v in rp.bbox],
                         uv=[round(rp.centroid[1],1), round(rp.centroid[0],1)],
                         zmin=round(float(P[:,2].min()),4), zmax=round(float(P[:,2].max()),4),
                         top_z=round(float(ct[2]+0),4), plane_n=np.round(nt,3).tolist(),
                         xy_min=np.round(P[:,:2].min(0),4).tolist(), xy_max=np.round(P[:,:2].max(0),4).tolist(),
                         centroid3=np.round(P.mean(0),4).tolist(), holes=[])
            for ha,hu,hv in hinfo[:2]:
                H = ray_plane(None,(hu,hv),K,T,ct,nt)
                entry["holes"].append(dict(area=int(ha), uv=[round(hu,1),round(hv,1)], xyz=np.round(H,4).tolist(),
                                           cz=round(float(H[2]),4)))
            res.append(entry)
    res.sort(key=lambda e:(e["cls"], e["uv"][0]))
    return res

def fit_circle(pts):
    x = pts[:,0]; y = pts[:,1]
    A = np.stack([2*x, 2*y, np.ones_like(x)],1)
    b = x*x + y*y
    sol,*_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A,b,rcond=None)
    cx,cy,k = sol
    r = np.sqrt(max(k + cx*cx + cy*cy, 1e-9))
    return cx,cy,r

def measure_peg(obs, camname, approx_xy, near_m=0.05, verbose=False):
    cam = obs.camera(camname)
    rgb = np.asarray(cam.rgb); dep = np.asarray(cam.depth_m).astype(float)
    K = cam.K; T = np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world)
    h = hsv_of(rgb); sat=h[...,1]; val=h[...,2]
    wm = (sat<0.13)&(val>0.70)
    lab = label(wm); rps = sorted(regionprops(lab), key=lambda r:-r.area)
    bm = np.zeros_like(wm)
    for rp in rps[:3]:
        if rp.area > 2000: bm |= (lab==rp.label)
    uv,P,_ = world_cloud(bm, dep, K, T)
    c,n,r = top_plane(P, tol=0.002)
    M = np.zeros(bm.shape, bool)
    M[uv[:,1].astype(int), uv[:,0].astype(int)] = r > 0.004
    lb = label(M)
    best=None
    for r2 in regionprops(lb):
        if r2.area < 30: continue
        m2 = (lb==r2.label); uv2,P2,_ = world_cloud(m2, dep, K, T)
        ctr = P2.mean(0)
        dist = float(np.linalg.norm(ctr[:2]-np.asarray(approx_xy)))
        if dist < near_m and (best is None or dist<best[0]):
            best = (dist, m2, uv2, P2)
    if best is None: return None
    dist, m2, uv2, P2 = best
    hh = (P2-c)@n
    topz = float(hh.max())
    upper = P2[hh > topz-0.0012]
    c0 = upper.mean(0)
    # silhouette: max radius per angular bin around c0
    ang = np.arctan2(P2[:,1]-c0[1], P2[:,0]-c0[0])
    rad = np.hypot(P2[:,0]-c0[0], P2[:,1]-c0[1])
    bins = np.floor((ang+np.pi)/(2*np.pi)*24).astype(int).clip(0,23)
    sil=[]
    for b in range(24):
        sel = bins==b
        if sel.sum()<1: continue
        i = np.argmax(rad[sel])
        sil.append(P2[sel][i,:2])
    sil = np.array(sil)
    cx,cy,rad_m = fit_circle(sil) if len(sil)>=6 else (c0[0],c0[1],np.nan)
    plate_z = float(c[2] + 0.0)
    return dict(xy=[round(float(cx),5), round(float(cy),5)], radius_m=round(float(rad_m),5),

import numpy as np
from skimage.measure import label, regionprops
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
from ora_lib import geometry as G
from pieces import colour_mask, world_cloud

def ransac_plane(P, tol=0.0015, iters=300, rng=None):
    rng = rng or np.random.default_rng(0)
    best=None
    n=len(P)
    for _ in range(iters):
        idx = rng.choice(n, 3, replace=False)
        p0,p1,p2 = P[idx]
        nn = np.cross(p1-p0, p2-p0)
        nrm = np.linalg.norm(nn)
        if nrm < 1e-9: continue
        nn = nn/nrm
        if nn[2] < 0: nn = -nn
        if nn[2] < 0.5: continue
        d = (P-p0)@nn
        inl = np.abs(d) < tol
        c = int(inl.sum())
        if best is None or c > best[0]:
            best = (c, nn, p0, inl)
    if best is None: return None
    c, nn, p0, inl = best
    Q = P[inl]
    ctr = Q.mean(0)
    u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(Q-ctr, full_matrices=False)
    nn = vt[2]
    if nn[2] < 0: nn = -nn
    return ctr, nn, inl

def held_piece3(obs, camname, colour, hint_xy, min_area=1000, res=0.0006):
    cam = obs.camera(camname)
    rgb = np.asarray(cam.rgb); dep = np.asarray(cam.depth_m).astype(float)
    K = cam.K; T = np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world)
    m = colour_mask(rgb, colour); m[:20,:]=False; m[-20:,:]=False
    lab = label(m); best=None
    for rp in regionprops(lab):
        if rp.area < min_area: continue
        mask=(lab==rp.label); uv,P,_=world_cloud(mask,dep,K,T)
        if len(P)<100: continue
        ctr=P.mean(0); d=float(np.linalg.norm(ctr[:2]-np.asarray(hint_xy)))
        if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,mask,uv,P,rp)
    if best is None: return None
    d,mask,uv,P,rp = best
    rp_res = ransac_plane(P)
    if rp_res is None: return None
    pctr, nrm, inl = rp_res
    # 2D basis in the plane
    e1 = np.array([1.0,0,0]); e1 = e1 - (e1@nrm)*nrm; e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1)
    e2 = np.cross(nrm, e1)
    rel = P - pctr
    uu = rel@e1; vv = rel@e2
    iu = np.round(uu/res).astype(int); iv = np.round(vv/res).astype(int)
    iu -= iu.min(); iv -= iv.min()
    W = iu.max()+1; H = iv.max()+1
    grid = np.zeros((H+1, W+1), bool)
    grid[iv, iu] = True
    grid = ndi.binary_closing(grid, np.ones((3,3)))
    filled = ndi.binary_fill_holes(grid)
    holes = filled & ~grid
    hl = label(holes); hinfo=[]
    for rr in regionprops(hl):
        if rr.area >= 40:
            hinfo.append(dict(area=int(rr.area), uv=[rr.centroid[1], rr.centroid[0]]))
    hinfo.sort(key=lambda h:-h["area"])
    hole=None
    if hinfo:
        h=hinfo[0]
        u = (h["uv"][0])*res; v = (h["uv"][1])*res
        Hc = pctr + u*e1 + v*e2
        hole = dict(area=h["area"], top_xyz=np.round(Hc,6).tolist(),
                    diam_m=round(float(2*np.sqrt(h["area"])*res/np.sqrt(np.pi)),5))
    # footprint rect in plane coords
    pts = np.stack([uu, vv],1)
    rect=None
    if len(pts) > 50:
        from shapely.geometry import MultiPoint
        mrr = MultiPoint(pts).minimum_rotated_rectangle
        cs = np.array(mrr.exterior.coords)[:4,:2]
        rc = cs.mean(0)
        f1 = cs[1]-cs[0]; l1=np.linalg.norm(f1); f1/=l1
        f2 = cs[2]-cs[1]; l2=np.linalg.norm(f2); f2/=l2
        if l1<l2: f1,f2,l1,l2 = f2,f1,l2,l1
        rect = dict(centre=np.round(pctr + rc[0]*e1 + rc[1]*e2, 6).tolist(),
                    ax_major=np.round(f1[0]*e1+f1[1]*e2,4).tolist(),
                    ax_minor=np.round(f2[0]*e1+f2[1]*e2,4).tolist(),
                    len_major=round(float(l1),5), len_minor=round(float(l2),5))
    return dict(normal=np.round(nrm,5).tolist(), plane_c=np.round(pctr,6).tolist(), inliers=int(inl.sum()),
                hole=hole, rect=rect, npx=int(rp.area), d=round(d,4),
                tilt_deg=round(float(np.degrees(np.arccos(min(1.0,abs(nrm[2]))))),2))
